title: Chicken Tinga
steps: Season the chicken well with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over high heat until shimmering. Add the chicken skin-side down and cook without moving until well browned, 6–8 minutes (lower the heat if it smokes a lot or starts to burn). Flip and cook 2 minutes more, then move to a plate.
Immediately add the tomatillos, tomatoes and garlic to the pot. Cook, turning occasionally, until blistered and browned in spots, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook, stirring, until softened, about 2 minutes. Add the oregano and bay leaves and cook until aromatic, about 30 seconds. Add the vinegar and stock.

Return the chicken, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a bare simmer. Cover and cook, turning the chicken occasionally, until the thickest part reaches 145°F (63°C), 20–30 minutes. Move the chicken to a bowl.
Simmer the sauce hard, stirring, until reduced by about half, about 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves, add the chipotles and adobo sauce, and blend until fairly smooth with a few small chunks.
When the chicken is cool enough to handle, discard the skin and bones and finely shred the meat. Return it to the sauce and stir in the fish sauce.
Simmer, stirring, until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken: very moist but not soupy. Season with salt and pepper.

variations.swap: Tacos, enchiladas, burritos, nachos, tostadas, sopes, or on its own.
